SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Age Limit

The age limit for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 is between 18 and 30 years, calculated as on the crucial date of 01.08.2026. Candidates must have been born not before 02.08.1996 and not later than 01.08.2008 to be eligible. Age relaxation is applicable to candidates belonging to reserved categories as per Government of India rules.

Category Age Limit / Relaxation
General (UR / EWS) 18 - 30 years (as on 01.08.2026)
SC / ST 5 years relaxation (max 35 years)
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years relaxation (max 33 years)
PwBD (UR) 10 years relaxation
PwBD (OBC) 13 years relaxation
PwBD (SC/ST) 15 years relaxation
Ex-Servicemen (ESM) 3 years after deduction of military service from actual age as on 01.08.2026

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Application Fee

The application fee for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 is ₹100 for General (UR), OBC, and EWS male candidates. Women candidates and candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), and Ex-Servicemen eligible for reservation are fully exempted from payment of fee.

Fee can be paid online only through BHIM UPI, Net Banking, or by using Visa, MasterCard, Maestro, or RuPay Debit Card. The fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances and will not be adjusted against any other examination. Candidates must ensure their fee payment is complete - if the fee is not received by SSC, the application status will show as "Incomplete" and will be summarily rejected.

General / OBC / EWS (Male) ₹100/-
Women / SC / ST / PwBD / Ex-Servicemen NIL (Exempted)

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Scheme of Examination

The SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 will consist of two papers. Paper-I is a Computer Based Examination with objective-type multiple choice questions, divided into two sections - General Hindi and General English - each carrying 100 marks with a sectional timer of 1 hour. There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in Paper-I.

Based on performance in Paper-I, candidates will be shortlisted category-wise to appear in Paper-II, which is a descriptive paper testing translation and essay writing skills in both Hindi and English, carrying 200 marks. Marks scored in Paper-I will be normalized if the exam is held in multiple shifts. Tentative Answer Keys will be uploaded after the exam, and candidates can submit online representations within the given time on payment of ₹50 per question (non-refundable).

Paper Mode Subject Questions / Marks Duration
Paper-I (Objective) Computer Based Part-I: General Hindi
Part-II: General English		 100/100
100/100		 2 Hours (Sectional timer: 1 hr each part)
{2 hrs 40 min for scribe-eligible candidates}
Paper-II (Descriptive) Pen & Paper Translation (Hindi ↔ English) & Essay 200 Marks 2 Hours
{2 hrs 40 min for scribe-eligible candidates}

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Selection Process

The selection process for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 consists of two stages. In the first stage, Paper-I (Computer Based Examination) is used to shortlist candidates category-wise for Paper-II. Minimum qualifying marks in Paper-I are 30% for UR, 25% for OBC/EWS, and 20% for all other categories. In the second stage, Paper-II (Descriptive) is conducted for shortlisted candidates.

For the final merit list, 50% weightage is given to Paper-I scores and 100% weightage to Paper-II marks. Final selection and allocation of Ministry/Department/Organization is based on merit-cum-preference of posts/departments exercised by candidates through an Online Option Form. In case of a tie, it is resolved by total marks in Paper-II, then date of birth (older preferred), and finally alphabetical order of names. Selected candidates will be on probation for 2 years and all posts carry All India Service Liability (AISL).

Stage Details
1. Paper-I (CBE) Objective type; used for shortlisting category-wise candidates for Paper-II. Minimum qualifying marks: UR 30%, OBC/EWS 25%, Others 20%
2. Paper-II (Descriptive) Translation passages (Hindi ↔ English) and Essay; 200 marks; qualifying based on Paper-I merit
3. Final Merit 50% weightage of Paper-I + 100% weightage of Paper-II marks
4. Post Preference & Allocation Online Option Form to be submitted before FRTA; merit-cum-preference based allocation
5. Document Verification Conducted by User Departments/Organizations after declaration of final result

Tie-Breaking Order

1st Higher total marks in Paper-II
2nd Date of Birth - older candidate preferred
3rd Alphabetical order of names of candidates

How to Apply for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026

The application process for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 is entirely online at https://ssc.gov.in. Candidates who have not yet completed their One-Time Registration (OTR) on the new SSC website must do so first, as the earlier OTR from the old website (ssc.nic.in) is not valid for the new portal. Aadhaar-based biometric authentication is available and recommended - candidates who opt for it will not face rejection on grounds of photograph or signature quality.

The application module is designed to capture a live photograph of the candidate through webcam or mobile device; pre-existing photographs must not be submitted. Candidates must also upload their scanned signature in JPEG/JPG format (10-20 KB). Applications with blurred or miniature photographs or signatures will be summarily rejected unless Aadhaar authentication has been opted for. Only one online application per candidate is permitted during the normal application period.

  • Visit the official website https://ssc.gov.in and complete One-Time Registration (OTR).
  • Login using Registration Number and Password.
  • Click on "Apply" under "Combined Hindi Translators Examination, 2026" in the Live Exam tab.
  • Fill in educational details, additional information (ESM/age relaxation), and examination centre preferences (up to 3 centres).
  • Capture live photograph through webcam/mobile as per instructions (no cap, mask, or spectacles).
  • Upload scanned signature in JPEG/JPG format (10-20 KB), dimensions ~6.0 cm (W) × 2.0 cm (H).
  • PwBD/PwD candidates must upload Disability Certificate as per Annexure-I/IA/X/XI, whichever is applicable.
  • Preview the application carefully, complete the declaration, and submit before 14.05.2026 (23:00 hours).
  • Pay the application fee (if applicable) online through BHIM UPI, Net Banking, or Debit Card on or before 15.05.2026 (23:00 hours).
  • Take a printout of the submitted application for future reference.

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Application Form

Eligible candidates who wish to apply for the SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 can do so by submitting their application form online only. The application process is entirely online, and candidates must ensure they complete all steps including OTR, form filling, photograph/signature upload, and fee payment before the respective closing dates.

The application form is accessible through the official SSC website after completing One-Time Registration. Candidates are strongly advised to fill the application carefully as only one application is accepted per candidate - multiple applications will lead to cancellation of candidature. Details such as name, father's name, mother's name, and date of birth must be filled exactly as they appear in the Matriculation Certificate. After final submission, modifications are only permitted during the correction window (19.05.2026 to 20.05.2026) on payment of correction charges.

Apply Online at: https://ssc.gov.in

Important Instructions for Candidates

Candidates applying for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 must read the official notification carefully in its entirety before filling and submitting the application form. The English version of the notice will prevail in case of any dispute. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the closing date to avoid last-minute server load issues on the SSC website. All candidatures are provisional - the Commission does not undertake detailed scrutiny at the time of the written examination, and eligibility will be verified only at the Document Verification stage by the User Departments. Any suppression or misrepresentation of information in the application can lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage, including after selection. Canvassing in any form will result in immediate disqualification. The decision of the Commission in all matters including eligibility, selection, and allocation of posts is final and binding.

  • Read the official notice carefully before applying; English version prevails in case of dispute.
  • Only one online application is permitted per candidate; multiple applications will be rejected.
  • Name, DOB, father's name, and mother's name must match the Matriculation Certificate exactly.
  • Candidates must keep a printout of their application for at least 3 years for future reference.
  • Post preference must be submitted online before FRTA declaration; options once submitted are final.
  • All posts carry All India Service Liability (AISL) - candidates may be posted anywhere in India.
  • Regularly check https://ssc.gov.in for updates on exam dates, vacancies, admit cards, and results.

Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) Notification 2026 has been released on the official website upsc.gov.in. A total of 5 vacancies have been announced through the UPSC Recruitment 2026 for Assistant Professor, Scientific Officer and More Posts.

FOLLOW US

Candidates who have qualifications such as Master’s Degree in Physics, B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical/Metallurgical/Electrical/Civil Engineering, or M.E./M.Tech in relevant disciplines with required experience are eligible to apply for these vacancies. The online application process for UPSC Recruitment 2026 has started and will remain open until 15-05-2026.

Candidates can download the official notification PDF and apply online through the direct links provided below in this article.

UPSC Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

  • Scientist-B (Mechanical): A) Master’s Degree in Physics + 1 year practical experience in testing/calibration of engineering materials/products or precision measurements/metrology OR B) B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical/Metallurgical Engineering + 2 years practical experience in testing/calibration of engineering materials/products or precision measurements/metrology (in recognized lab/institute). Desirable: R&D experience in testing of engineering materials and metrology/calibration.
  • Scientific Officer (Non-Destructive): Master’s Degree in Physics OR B.E./B.Tech in Electrical/Mechanical/Metallurgy + 1 year experience in Non-Destructive testing Laboratory OR 1 year experience in X-Ray Diffraction or investigation of failure of Engineering Material by Non-Destructive and metallographic methods.
  • Superintending Archaeological Engineer: Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering + Eight years’ experience in Planning, Execution and Supervision of Civil Engineering works in Government Sector or Archaeological/Heritage Sites.
  • Assistant Professor, Civil Engineering (Survey): B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering + M.E./M.Tech in Civil Engineering (Geo Informatics / Geoinformatics and Surveying Technology) with first class or equivalent either at Bachelor’s or Master’s level.

NMDC Limited, a Navaratna Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Steel, Government of India, has released the Employment Notification No. 04/2026 dated 22 April 2026 for the post of Junior Engineer (Mining) on a contractual basis for its various mining projects. Eligible candidates with a Diploma in Mining Engineering aged up to 50 years can apply online from 22.04.2026 to 06.05.2026 through the official NMDC website www.nmdc.co.in. The official notification PDF and application details are available below.

NMDC Junior Engineer Mining Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

This recruitment is part of NMDC's massive expansion and diversification drive both in India and abroad. Candidates can download the official notification from the Careers page of the NMDC website and check category-wise vacancies, eligibility, terms of contract, application fee, and selection process before applying online. NMDC Junior Engineer Mining Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Before applying for NMDC Junior Engineer Mining Recruitment 2026, candidates must carefully verify that they meet all eligibility requirements as specified in the official notification. The mandatory qualification required is a 3-year Diploma in Mining Engineering from a University or Institution recognized by UGC/AICTE/Government of India.

Possession of any higher qualification other than the prescribed essential qualification does not make a candidate eligible for this post. Proof of qualification must be uploaded during the online application and also produced in original at the time of Document Verification. The desirable qualification is a Foreman's Certificate of Competency for metalliferous mines, which though not mandatory, will be an added advantage.

Remuneration will be calculated based on actual attendance and prorated deductions will be made for absence.

In addition to the consolidated pay, selected candidates will be entitled to several benefits including Accidental Group Insurance coverage for accidents arising out of or during the course of employment, outpatient expenses for self-treatment of ₹35,000/- per annum, House Rent Allowance (HRA) as applicable, and TA/DA for official tours.

Candidates will also be entitled to 12 days of Casual Leave and 20 days of Medical Leave per calendar year. Un-availed Casual Leave cannot be carried forward and encashment of Casual Leave is not permitted. Selected candidates are also eligible for weekly rest days and public holidays as per Company rules. Candidates who are unable to produce the required original documents meeting the essential eligibility criteria will not be allowed to attend the assessment and will not be reimbursed Travelling Allowance.

The merit list will be drawn based on the candidates' performance in the Supervisory Skill Assessment. NMDC Management reserves the right to alter or fix the criteria for calling candidates for the assessment based on the number of applications received. The decision of NMDC Management will be final in all matters relating to the selection process and no interim correspondence will be entertained.

Before applying on the STPI portal, candidates must mandatorily register on the NATS Portal (https://nats.education.gov.in) and obtain their unique NATS Enrolment ID, which is required to be entered in the STPI online application form.

Keep all educational certificates, identity documents, and bank account details ready before starting the NATS registration. After successful NATS registration, visit STPI's official website www.stpi.in, go to the Career Section, and complete the online application before 11/05/2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance and not wait until the last date to avoid technical difficulties.

  • Step 1: Register on the NATS Portal at https://nats.education.gov.in and obtain your unique NATS Enrolment ID (refer to Annexure A in the notification for step-by-step instructions).
  • Step 2: Visit STPI's official website www.stpi.in → Career Section.
  • Step 3: Fill in the online application form with all required details including the NATS Enrolment ID.
  • Step 4: Upload required documents as specified in the application form.
  • Step 5: Submit the online application on or before 11/05/2026.
  • Step 6: Take a printout of the submitted application form for future reference.

NATS Portal Registration Guide for STPI Apprentice Trainee 2026

Registration on the NATS Portal (National Apprenticeship Training Scheme - https://nats.education.gov.in) is mandatory for all candidates before applying on the STPI portal. The NATS Enrolment ID generated after registration must be entered in the STPI online application - applications without this ID will not be accepted.

The stipend will also be processed through NATS via DBT, so accurate bank account details must be provided during registration. A step-by-step guide (Annexure A) is included in the official notification. The key steps are summarised below for quick reference.

Step Action Details
Step 1 Visit NATS Portal Go to https://nats.education.gov.in → Click on "Student" in the top menu bar
Step 2 Enrol as a Student Click "Enroll" under Student section → Read eligibility criteria → Click "Yes" if eligible → Proceed to Enrollment Form
Step 3 Fill Personal Information Enter name, date of birth, gender, email, mobile number → Create login ID and password → Enter Aadhaar number and other identification details
Step 4 Fill Educational Details Select highest qualification (Diploma / Graduate) → Enter institution name, year of passing, percentage/CGPA
Step 5 Fill Communication & Bank Details Enter present and permanent address → Enter bank account number, IFSC code, and bank name (for DBT stipend processing)
Step 6 Review and Submit Review all details carefully → Submit the registration form → Unique NATS Enrolment ID generated and sent to registered email ID

  • NATS Portal registration at https://nats.education.gov.in is mandatory before applying on STPI portal.

  • Candidates who have already completed apprenticeship anywhere are not eligible.
  • Reservation as per Govt. of India rules: preference to 3-OBC, 2-SC, 1-ST out of 15 posts.
  • Stipend paid through DBT via NATS portal - ensure bank details are correctly entered during NATS registration.
  • Applications received after 11/05/2026 will not be considered under any circumstances.

The application fee is non-refundable and must be paid online at the time of registration regardless of whether the candidate is shortlisted for Field Trials or not. Bank of Baroda Sportspersons Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection process consists of two main stages: Shortlisting/Screening of applications followed by Field Trials for shortlisted candidates. In the first stage, applications will be screened against the eligibility criteria including educational qualifications, relevant sports experience, domain expertise, and suitability. Meeting the minimum eligibility criteria does not automatically entitle a candidate to be called for Field Trials - the Bank may call candidates in a ratio as deemed appropriate at its sole discretion. The shortlisting criteria are internal and confidential and will not be shared with candidates.

Shortlisted candidates will be called for Field Trials at a designated venue, the evaluation criteria and qualifying cut-off for which will be determined solely by the Bank. No requests for change of centre, venue, date, or time for Field Trials will be entertained. The Bank's decision on shortlisting and selection at all stages is final and binding. Selected candidates must be Active Sportspersons at the time of joining and fit enough to participate in future tournaments. All selected sportspersons will be required to sign a written undertaking to play for the Bank's team whenever required.

Stage 2: Field Trials Shortlisted candidates called for Field Trials at designated venue. Evaluation criteria and qualifying cut-off determined solely by the Bank.
Stage 3: Document Verification Original documents to be produced at the time of Field Trials / as called by the Bank. Failure to produce documents will debar candidature.

The application process is entirely online - no other mode of application will be accepted. Candidates must visit the Bank's official website www.bankofbaroda.bank.in and apply through the Careers → Current Opportunities section. Before starting the application, candidates must ensure they have a valid personal email ID and active mobile number, a scanned passport-size photograph (20–50 KB, JPG format), a scanned signature in black ink on white paper (10–20 KB, JPG format), and scanned PDF copies of all required documents within the specified file sizes (maximum 500 KB per file).

A printout of the system-generated application form and e-receipt should be retained for future reference.

The selected candidates will be required to execute an Indemnity Bond undertaking to serve the Bank for a minimum period of 03 years, or to pay the Bank a sum of ₹3,00,000/- (Rupees Three Lakhs Only) in case they leave before completion of 03 years of active service. Candidates must also maintain a healthy credit history with a minimum CIBIL score of 681 or above at the time of joining the Bank.

PNB Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection process for PNB Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026 will be based on an Online Written Test followed by a Personal Interview, or a Personal Interview only, depending upon the number of applications received against each post. The Bank may decide to follow either of two scenarios. Under Scenario 1 (Online Written Test + Interview):

The written test consists of Part I covering Reasoning (25 marks), English Language (25 marks), and Quantitative Aptitude (50 marks) - totalling 100 marks - and Part II covering Professional Knowledge (50 questions, 100 marks), with the entire test to be completed in 120 minutes.

For each wrong answer, one-fourth of the marks assigned will be deducted as penalty. Part II (Professional Knowledge) will be evaluated only for candidates who qualify in each paper of Part I. Candidates who qualify Part I will be shortlisted for interview based on marks in Part II. Personal Interview will carry 50 marks, and candidates must score minimum qualifying marks in the interview to be considered for final selection.

The final merit will be based on aggregate scores of Part II of the Online Written Test and the Interview. Under Scenario 2 (Shortlisting + Interview): Applications will be screened, eligible candidates will be called for a Personal Interview of 50 marks, and final selection will be based solely on interview scores.

SSB Head Constable Eligibility Criteria 2026

  • Nationality: Only Indian citizens are eligible for appointment to SSB Head Constable posts, and no person who is not a citizen of India shall be appointed except with prior written permission of the Central Government; subjects of Nepal or Bhutan may be considered as per rules.

Post-wise Educational Qualification

Post Name Educational & Professional Qualification
Head Constable (Steward) 12th class pass from a recognised Board; Diploma of minimum two years duration in Catering and Kitchen Management from an institution recognised by the Central or State Government; and minimum one year working experience as Steward in a minimum 100‑bedded hospital or institution recognised by Central/State Government.
Head Constable (Communication) 12th class pass in Science with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics from a recognised Board; OR three years Diploma in Electronics or Communications or Computer Science or Information Technology from a recognised Institute.
Head Constable (Electrician) Matriculation or equivalent from a recognised Board with either (i) two years work experience in the respective trade, or (ii) one year certificate course from recognised ITI/Vocational Institute with at least one year experience in the trade, or (iii) two years Diploma from recognised ITI in the respective trade or similar trade; must qualify the trade test.
Head Constable (Veterinary) 12th class pass with Science and Biology as main subject from a recognised Board and two years Diploma Course in Veterinary and Livestock Development or Veterinary Stock Assistant Course or Animal Husbandry Course from an institution recognised by Central or State Government.

Candidates must possess the prescribed educational and professional qualifications and all required certificates in original as on the last date of receipt of applications, failing which their candidature will be rejected.

  • For UR / EWS / OBC candidates: ₹100/- (Rupees One Hundred only) as non‑refundable examination fee.
  • For SC / ST / Ex‑Servicemen / Female candidates: No fee (Exempted) as per SSB recruitment rules.
  • Mode of Payment: Net Banking, Credit Card, Debit Card, UPI or other online modes through the payment gateway integrated with the SSB recruitment portal.
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded in any circumstances, and candidates are advised to avoid multiple payments against a single registration. 

SSB Head Constable Selection Process 2026

  • Stage I – Physical Efficiency Test (PET) & Physical Standard Test (PST):
    • PET – Male: 1.6 Km run in 6 Minutes 30 Seconds; Female: 800 Meter race in 4 minutes.
    • Ex-Servicemen are exempted from PET but must appear in PST, Written Examination, Skill Test (as applicable), Documentation and Medical Examination.
    • PST – Candidates must meet prescribed height and chest standards (post-wise and category-wise as per notification).
    • General (UR/EWS/OBC): Male – 165 cm height, 75–80 cm chest; Female – 155 cm height (Head Constable Steward). Different standards apply for SC/ST, NE States, J&K and other specified categories.
  • Stage II – Written Examination (Computer Based Test – CBT):
    • Paper-I Common Entrance Test: 3 hours duration, 150 marks, 150 multiple-choice objective type questions.
    • Part-I (50 Marks): General Knowledge, Mathematics, Reasoning, General English/General Hindi.
    • Part-II (100 Marks): Technical Subject.
    • Minimum qualifying marks: 50% for Gen/EWS/OBC/Ex-SM; 45% for SC/ST.
    • Final Merit will be prepared on the basis of marks obtained by candidates in the written examination.
  • Stage III – Skill Test (Only for Head Constable Electrician):
    • Skill test will be conducted for up to 20 times the vacancies (category-wise) for the post of Head Constable (Electrician).
    • Skill test carries 50 marks; minimum qualifying marks for all categories including SC/ST/OBC/EWS/Ex-Servicemen: 60%.
    • Skill test is qualifying in nature. Marks of skill test will not be included in the final merit list.
  • Stage IV – Document Verification (DV) and Detailed Medical Examination (DME) / Review Medical Examination (RME):
    • Candidates shortlisted up to 3 times the vacancies (category-wise) will be called for Documentation and DME/RME.
    • All original documents will be verified by detailed BOOs of SSB.
    • Candidates declared unfit in DME may prefer an appeal for Review Medical Examination (RME). The decision of RME Board will be final and no 2nd appeal will be entertained.
  • Final Selection: Final selection list will be prepared in order of merit, category-wise, after completion of Review Medical Examination. Where equal marks are obtained: candidate with more marks in Part-II (Technical Subject) will rank higher; if still equal, senior in age will rank higher; if date of birth is also same, priority based on alphabetical order of names in English.

SSB Head Constable Exam Pattern 2026

The written examination for SSB Head Constable (Steward, Communication, Electrician & Veterinary) will be conducted in Computer Based Test mode with objective-type questions from General Knowledge, Mathematics, Reasoning, General English/General Hindi and technical subjects relevant to the trade. Detailed syllabus, marking scheme, language of question paper and sample pattern will be published with the detailed notification and on the official SSB recruitment website, and candidates are advised to refer to the latest scheme before starting preparation.

SSB Head Constable Salary / Remuneration 2026

Pay Component Details
Head Constable (Steward, Communication, Electrician, Veterinary) Level‑4 Pay Matrix (7th CPC) with basic pay ₹25,500 – 81,100 per month along with applicable Dearness Allowance, Ration Money Allowance, House Rent Allowance and other admissible allowances as per SSB and Government of India rules.
Allowances & Benefits In addition to basic pay, Head Constables are entitled to DA, HRA (or government accommodation where admissible), Ration Money, medical facilities, leave benefits, uniforms and other central government allowances from time to time.
Pension Scheme Selected candidates will be covered under the Defined Contributory Pension Scheme (New Pension Scheme) or Unified Defined Contributory Pension Scheme (UPS) applicable to new entrants in Central Government services as per prevailing rules.

How to Apply for SSB Head Constable Recruitment 2026

  • Candidates are advised to go through the instructions and detailed advertisement available on SSB official website https://recruitment.ssb.gov.in/ & https://ssb.gov.in/ carefully before filling up the application form.
  • Applications must be submitted through Online Mode Only. Applications received through any other mode shall not be accepted.
  • Fill all fields in the application form including: Post applied, Candidate's Name, Father's/Husband's Name, Mother's Name, Date of Birth (in DD/MM/YYYY format as per matriculation certificate), Gender, Nationality, Religion, Marital Status, Category, Education Qualification, Postal/Permanent Address, Aadhaar Number (or valid Photo Identity Card number), Identification Marks, Mobile Number, E-mail ID, Criminal Cases Declaration.
  • Upload passport size coloured photograph in JPG format (less than 12 KB and greater than 4 KB, resolution 100 pixel width × 120 pixel height, white background with 75% face visible).
  • Upload signature in JPG format (less than 12 KB and greater than 4 KB, resolution 140 pixel width × 60 pixel height).
  • Pay the requisite fee of ₹100/- (for UR/EWS/OBC) through Net Banking / Credit Card / Debit Card / UPI. SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen/Women candidates are exempted from fee payment.
  • After successful submission, note down the Registration Number generated and take a printout of the application form/acknowledgement for future reference.
  • Application form can be edited by clicking "Edit Details" button till the closing/last date of receipt of online application form. After submission, no request for change/correction will be entertained.
  • Reporting to Recruitment Venue: Admit Cards can be downloaded from the SSB Recruitment website. Candidates must report to the venue on the date mentioned in the Admit Card with all original documents including Identity certificate, educational qualification certificates, Caste Certificates, Aadhaar Card etc.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Posts are temporary but likely to continue. Selected candidates are liable to serve anywhere in India or outside the Territory of India and will be governed by SSB Act & Rules and other Rules amended from time to time.
  • A candidate can apply for only one post from amongst the posts mentioned in the notification.
  • Applications received through any mode except Online Mode shall not be accepted and rejected straightway.
  • SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates who fulfill eligibility criteria of unreserved category may apply against the unreserved category for posts where no vacancies are reserved for SC/ST/OBC/EWS.
  • OBC Non-Creamy Layer status should have been obtained within three years of the closing date of receipt of applications.
  • EWS certificate should be valid for 2026-27 as per Annexure-III. Family gross annual income must be below ₹8,00,000/-.
  • Biometrics of both thumbs (Left & Right) of candidates will be taken for verification in all stages after attendance.
  • Persons employed in Government/Semi-Government/Public Sector Undertakings should apply through proper channel and submit NOC from their employer at the time of documentation.
  • Name, Father's Name & Date of Birth should be mentioned exactly as recorded in the Matriculation certificate.
  • Candidates should be prepared for a stay of at least one week at the recruitment venue at their own arrangement. No TA/DA will be admissible.
  • Unemployed SC/ST candidates appearing in the written test will be reimbursed fare as admissible under relevant Rules subject to production of Rail/Bus tickets, original caste certificate and Non-employment certificate issued by MP or MLA or any Gazetted Officer.
  • Persons with bigamy/marriage to a person with a living spouse are disqualified. Conviction by court of law or dismissal from Government service also leads to disqualification.
  • Calculator, Digital Diary, Cellular Phone, pager, Whiteners, blade etc. are prohibited in the recruitment venue.
  • The DG, SSB has full right to make changes/cancel/postpone the recruitment without assigning any reason.
  • There will be no provision of reserve merit list/panel. If vacancies remain unfilled after declaration of final result, the same will be carried forward for the next recruitment.
  • Any amendment in the schedule/condition/process of recruitment will be available on SSB official website https://recruitment.ssb.gov.in/ & https://ssb.gov.in/ only.

Constables (Gardener, Water Carrier, Cobbler, Tailor, Washerman, Barber, Waiter) Matriculation or equivalent plus either (i) two years work experience in the respective trade, or (ii) one year certificate course from a recognised ITI/Vocational Institute with at least one year experience in the trade, or (iii) two years diploma from a recognised ITI in the trade or similar trade; must qualify trade test; multi‑skilled candidates will be given preference.
Constable (Carpenter) Matriculation or equivalent and either (i) two years work experience in the trade, or (ii) one year ITI/Vocational certificate with one year experience, or (iii) two years ITI diploma in the trade; must qualify trade test.
Constable (Nursing Orderly) 10th pass from a recognised board, First Aid certificate from St. John’s Ambulance Organisation or Red Cross Society of India, and at least one year working experience as Nursing Orderly in a minimum 50‑bedded hospital/institution recognised by Central/State Government.

Candidates who are appearing in examinations, awaiting results or not in possession of the required educational/professional certificates on or before the last date of application should not apply for SSB Constable Tradesman & Driver Recruitment 2026.

SSB Constable Tradesman & Driver Application Fee 2026

  • For UR / EWS / OBC candidates: ₹100/- (non-refundable examination fee) to be paid through net banking, credit card, debit card, UPI or other online modes as available on the SSB recruitment portal.
  • For SC / ST / Ex-Servicemen / Female candidates: No fee (Exempted) as per SSB recruitment rules.
  • Applications submitted without successful online fee payment (where applicable) will be rejected, so candidates must ensure completion of fee payment and retain proof of transaction.

SSB Constable Tradesman & Driver Selection Process 2026

  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET): For Constables (Veterinary, Driver, Gardener, Water Carrier, Cobbler, Tailor, Washerman, Barber, Waiter, Carpenter & Nursing Orderly), PET consists of 4.8 km race in 24 minutes for male candidates and 2.4 km race in 18 minutes for female candidates; Ex-Servicemen are exempted from PET but must appear for other stages.
  • Physical Standard Test (PST): Candidates who qualify PET will undergo PST where height, chest (for male) and weight are measured as per category/region-wise standards; candidates not meeting minimum standards will be rejected.
  • Written Examination: Objective-type written test as per SSB pattern covering General Knowledge, Elementary Mathematics, Reasoning and Trade-related subjects; detailed scheme and syllabus will be notified on the SSB website.
  • Trade/Skill Test: Practical trade test for Tradesman posts and driving/maintenance test for Constable (Driver) to assess hands-on skills; qualifying in nature as per prescribed criteria.
  • Documentation & Medical Examination: Verification of original documents, certificates, category and age proofs followed by medical examination as per SSB medical standards; only medically fit candidates will be considered for final selection.

SSB Constable Tradesman & Driver Exam Pattern 2026

The SSB Constable written examination for Tradesman, Driver, Veterinary and other Constable posts will consist of objective-type questions from General Knowledge, Elementary Mathematics, General Reasoning and Trade-related subjects as per the SSB prescribed syllabus. Detailed exam pattern, number of questions, marking scheme and language of question paper will be published in the detailed recruitment notification and on the official SSB website, and candidates should refer to the latest scheme before starting preparation.

SSB Constable Tradesman & Driver Salary 2026

Pay Component Details
Constable (All Trades including Driver, Veterinary, Nursing Orderly) Pay Level-3 of 7th CPC pay matrix with basic pay ₹21,700–69,100 plus applicable Dearness Allowance, Ration Money Allowance, House Rent Allowance and other admissible allowances.
Allowances & Benefits Central government benefits including DA, HRA (or government accommodation where admissible), Ration Money, medical facilities, leave, uniforms and other allowances as per SSB/GoI rules.
Pension Scheme Candidates will be covered under Defined Contributory Pension Scheme / Unified Pension Scheme as applicable to new entrants in Central Government service.

SSB Constable Tradesman & Driver Documents Required

Candidates will be required to upload scanned copies of documents at the time of online application and produce originals during documentation and medical examination.

  • Recent passport size colour photograph and signature as per prescribed size and format.
  • Matriculation / 10th pass certificate and mark sheet as proof of date of birth and educational qualification.
  • ITI certificates, trade experience certificates, Heavy Vehicle Driving Licence (for Driver post) and First Aid certificate (for Nursing Orderly) as applicable.
  • Caste certificate for SC / ST / OBC (NCL), EWS certificate, issued in prescribed Government of India format, if applicable.
  • Domicile certificate, Ex-Servicemen discharge certificate, NOC from employer for Govt/PSU employees and other supporting documents wherever claimed.

How to Apply for SSB Constable Tradesman & Driver Recruitment 2026

  • Candidates must apply online only through the SSB recruitment portal by visiting https://recruitment.ssb.gov.in/ or the link available at https://ssb.gov.in/.
  • Open the Constable (Tradesman & Driver) recruitment link and read the detailed advertisement carefully to ensure that you meet all eligibility conditions.
  • Register with a valid mobile number and email ID, then log in and fill all required details such as personal information, category, address, educational qualifications and trade details exactly as per certificates.
  • Upload scanned copies of recent passport-size photograph, signature and relevant documents/certificates in the prescribed format and size.
  • Pay the examination fee (if applicable) online through net banking, credit card, debit card or UPI and ensure successful transaction before final submission.
  • Preview the filled application form carefully, correct any mistakes if allowed, and then submit the form online on or before 04 May 2026.
  • After successful submission, download and take a printout of the final submitted application form and fee receipt for future reference.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Only eligible candidates should apply and must carefully go through all provisions and requirements in the official notification to ensure they are eligible for the post applied for; candidature will be cancelled at any stage if found ineligible.
  • Candidates must bring all original documents such as Matriculation certificate, trade/ITI certificates, experience certificates, category certificates along with self-attested photocopies at the time of documentation, failing which their candidature will be rejected.
  • Name, father’s name and date of birth should exactly match the Matriculation certificate; any change must be supported by valid documents, otherwise candidature is liable to be rejected.
  • Government/Semi-Government/PSU employees should apply through proper channel and must produce No Objection Certificate from their employer at the time of documentation.
  • Falsification or forgery of documents to mislead the recruitment board will invite legal action, cancellation of candidature and debarment from future SSB examinations.
  • Admit cards/call letters for PET, PST, written exam, trade test and documentation will be uploaded on SSB official website only, and candidates must regularly visit recruitment.ssb.gov.in and ssb.gov.in for updates.
  • Mere qualifying all prescribed tests does not confer any right to final selection; the decision of the SSB Recruitment Board will be final and binding.
  • The DG, SSB reserves absolute discretion to cancel, postpone or make changes in the recruitment process without assigning any reason.

The Indian Army Territorial Army Directorate (Territorial Army) has published the Territorial Army Officer Notification 2026 under Advt. No. TAC-026. The recruitment drive aims to fill 12 Territorial Army Officer positions in the rank of Lieutenant. Candidates within the age range of 18 to 42 years and holding a Graduate degree from a recognised university along with gainful employment status are eligible to apply online at indianarmy.nic.in. The application process will be active from 20 April 2026 (1000 Hours) to 19 May 2026 (2355 Hours), and candidates can easily access the notification PDF and apply link below.

Territorial Army Commission 2026 Notification PDF

The Indian Army has officially released the advertisement for Territorial Army Commission - 2026 (TAC-026) inviting online applications from eligible gainfully employed Indian citizens for commission as Territorial Army Officers. The notification contains complete details regarding eligibility conditions, examination pattern, syllabus, selection procedure, terms and conditions of service, pay scales, and the list of documents required at the time of SSB Interview. Candidates are strongly advised to download and read the official notification thoroughly before filling out and submitting their online application. Mere submission of application does not guarantee admission to the examination. All further updates and admit card details will be published on the official Indian Army website.

Candidates are required to pay an examination fee of ₹500/- (Rupees Five Hundred only) for Territorial Army Commission 2026. Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances, nor can the fee be held in reserve for any other examination or selection. Candidates are advised to retain proof of fee payment for future reference.

Territorial Army Commission 2026 Salary / Pay Scale

Officers commissioned in the Territorial Army will receive pay and allowances at par with Regular Army Officers when embodied for training and military service as per the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC) pay matrix. Commission is granted in the rank of Lieutenant with a pay level of 10 in the pay matrix. In addition to basic pay, officers receive Military Service Pay (MSP) of ₹15,500/- per month.

However, since Territorial Army is a part-time commitment with mandatory two months of training per year, pay and allowances are applicable only during the period of embodiment for training or military service. Serving in the Territorial Army does not guarantee pension, which is subject to embodied service as per organisational requirement. Promotions up to Lt Colonel are by time scale subject to fulfilling laid-down criteria, while promotion to Colonel and Brigadier is by selection.

Candidates must ensure they provide their valid and active email IDs and mobile numbers in the application form, as the concerned authorities will use electronic mode of communication at different stages of the examination process.

Candidates must carefully decide their choice of examination centre while filling in the application form, as no request for change of centre will be granted after submission. Brief instructions for filling up the online Application Form IAF (TA)-9 (Revised) Part-1 are available on the official website. Candidates are advised to keep a printout of the filled and submitted online application form for future reference. Payment of the examination fee of ₹500/- must be made through the prescribed online modes only.

  • Visit the official website www.indianarmy.nic.in
  • Complete online registration and fill Application Form IAF (TA)-9 (Revised) Part-1
  • Provide valid email ID and active mobile number
  • Select the preferred examination centre carefully (no change will be permitted later)
  • Pay the examination fee of ₹500/- through the prescribed online mode
  • Submit the application and retain a printed copy for future reference

Territorial Army Commission 2026 Application Form

The online application form for Territorial Army Commission 2026 - Form IAF (TA)-9 (Revised) Part-1 - is available exclusively on the official Indian Army website at www.indianarmy.nic.in. The form requires candidates to fill in their personal details, educational qualification details, employment details, and choice of examination centre. Candidates must ensure all details are accurately filled and match the supporting documents, as any discrepancy found at any stage may lead to disqualification. The online application window is open from 20 April 2026 (1000 Hours) to 19 May 2026 (2355 Hours) only. Candidates who qualify the CBT will additionally be required to download and fill Application Form IAF (TA)-9 (Revised) Part-2 in their own handwriting and bring it at the time of SSB Interview. Candidates must apply well before the last date to avoid any last-minute connectivity or technical issues.

Apply Online at: www.indianarmy.nic.in

Important Instructions for Candidates

Candidates applying for Territorial Army Commission 2026 must carefully read all instructions mentioned in the official notification before submitting their application. Territorial Army is a part-time commitment with mandatory two months of training per year and does not guarantee a full-time career or pension. Serving members of the Regular Army, Navy, Air Force, Police, GREF, Para Military, and like forces are not eligible to apply. Admission at all stages of the examination will be purely provisional, and mere issue of the Admit Card does not imply final clearance of candidature by the competent authority.

The Territorial Army Directorate reserves the discretion to fix qualifying marks in any or all subjects of the examination and has the right to conduct the CBT at all cities or any of the cities depending upon the number of candidates and other compulsions. No request for change of examination centre will be entertained. Fee once paid will not be refunded. The Objection Management Link will be hosted on the official website 72 hours after the examination for a period of three days only, allowing candidates to raise concerns regarding questions and answer keys.

  • Serving members of Regular Army/Navy/Air Force/Police/GREF/Para Military are NOT eligible.
  • Territorial Army is a part-time commitment - it does not guarantee full-time career or pension.
  • No request for change of examination centre will be granted.
  • Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.
  • Mere issue of Admit Card does not imply final clearance of candidature.

  • Objection Management Link will be live for only three days after the examination.
  • Candidates must keep their registered email ID and mobile number active throughout the process.

RRB Group D Eligibility Criteria 2026 – Quick Overview

Here are the key points at a glance:

  • Minimum Education: 10th pass (Matriculation) from a recognized board, or ITI from NCVT/SCVT, or National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) in relevant trade.

  • Age Range: Generally 18–33 years (calculated as on the cutoff date mentioned in the notification, such as 01.01.2026).

  • Nationality Requirement: Primarily Indian citizens; certain other categories like subjects of Nepal/Bhutan or specified migrants are eligible with proper certificates.

  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Medical Standards: Mandatory qualifying stages after CBT.

  • Category-wise Age Relaxation: Available for OBC, SC/ST, Ex-servicemen, PwBD, and others as per rules.

RRB Group D Educational Qualification 2026

The minimum educational qualification for RRB Group D 2026 requires candidates to have:

  • Passed Class 10/Matriculation from a recognized board, or

  • ITI certificate from NCVT/SCVT in a relevant trade, or

  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) granted by NCVT.

Equivalence like NIOS/open schooling is generally accepted if recognized and mentioned in the official notification—always verify the exact clause in the CEN PDF. Final-year or appearing candidates are typically not eligible; the qualification must be completed by the application closing date.

Common doubts:

  • Gap years or backlogs do not disqualify if the certificate is obtained.

  • Subject stream usually does not matter for non-technical posts.

  • Always cross-check with the official notification to avoid issues.

RRB Group D Age Limit 2026

The general age limit for RRB Group D 2026 is 18 to 33 years, calculated as on the date specified in the notification (e.g., 01.01.2026). Candidates must fall within this range before applying.

RRB Group D Nationality Criteria 2026

Under RRB Group D nationality criteria, candidates must be:

  • A citizen of India, or

  • A subject of Nepal or Bhutan, or

  • A Tibetan refugee who came to India before January 1, 1962 (with intent to settle permanently), or

  • A person of Indian origin migrated from specified countries (Pakistan, Burma, etc.) with an eligibility certificate from the Government of India.

Most applicants qualify as Indian citizens.

RRB Group D Physical Eligibility & PET 2026

The RRB Group D physical standards include two stages: PET (qualifying) and medical examination.

Physical Efficiency Test (PET) Requirements

PET is qualifying (pass/fail) and conducted for shortlisted CBT candidates. Typical requirements (as per notification; may vary slightly):

  • Male candidates: Running a specified distance in given time, lifting/carrying weight over distance.

  • Female candidates: Adjusted distance/weight parameters.

Only those passing PET proceed further.

RRB Group D Medical Standards 2026

The medical exam follows document verification and includes vision (distant/near), color vision, blood pressure, cardiac, hearing, and general fitness checks. Posts fall under A-2, B-1, C-1, etc., categories candidates must meet the standards for allotted posts.

Common disqualifying reasons include poor eyesight beyond limits, uncontrolled chronic conditions, or major disabilities incompatible with duties. Exact conditions are in the official rules.

Important Documents Required for RRB Group D Eligibility Verification

Candidates need these for various stages (especially document verification):

  • 10th/Matriculation certificate and mark sheet.

  • ITI/NAC certificate (if applicable).

  • Category certificates (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS in central format).

  • PwBD certificate (if claiming).

  • Ex-servicemen discharge certificate.

  • Photo ID (Aadhaar, Voter ID, etc.).

  • Passport-size photographs (per specs).

Who Is Not Eligible for RRB Group D 2026?

  • Candidates below 18 or above 33 years (even after relaxation).

  • Those without required 10th/ITI/NAC by cutoff date.

  • Non-eligible nationality or missing certificates.

  • Failing PET or medical exam.

  • Incomplete, incorrect, or forged documents.

  • Debarred by RRB or with disqualifying background (if specified).

How to Apply for GMRCL Non-Executives 2026 Recruitment

Applications must be submitted online only through the official GMRCL website. No hard copy or offline applications will be accepted. Candidates are advised to complete the application process well before the last date to avoid last-minute technical issues.

Step-by-Step Guide to Apply Online:

  1. Visit the official GMRCL website: https://www.gujaratmetrorail.com
  2. Click on the “Careers” section or directly go to the recruitment link.
  3. Select the GMRCL O&M Non-Executives Recruitment 2026 advertisement from the drop-down menu.
  4. Click on “Apply” or “Apply Now” against the advertisement.
  5. If you already have a One Time Registration (OTR) number, enter your OTR Number and Date of Birth to auto-fill your details. If you do not have an OTR number, click on “SKIP” or register fresh by filling in your personal details (Name, Father’s/Husband’s Name, Mother’s Name, Gender, Date of Birth, Category, Address, Mobile Number, Email ID, Aadhaar Number, Educational Qualification, etc.). An OTR number will be generated and sent to your registered mobile and email.
  6. Fill up all the required details carefully in the online application form.
  7. Upload your recent passport size colour photograph and signature as per the prescribed specifications (Photograph: max 15 KB, Signature: max 15 KB).
  8. Carefully preview all the details filled in the application form. Make corrections if needed before final submission. No changes will be allowed after submission.
  9. Click on the “Submit” button.
  10. Proceed to the Payment section and pay the applicable application fee online using Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, UPI, or Wallet.
  11. After successful payment, an e-Receipt will be generated. Download and take a printout of the e-Receipt and the filled-in online application form for future reference

  • Candidates can apply from 29 April 2026 to 28 May 2026.

  • Candidates should have a valid email ID and mobile number.
  • Scan and upload recent passport size photograph and signature as per specifications.
  • Government employees must submit NOC at the time of document verification.
  • Candidates can apply for only one post.
  • The name filled in the application must exactly match the name in your educational certificates and photo identity proof.
  • Photograph and signature must be clear. Blurry images may lead to rejection.
  • Application fee once paid is non-refundable.
  • Government employees must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of document verification.
  • Candidates are advised to apply well before the closing date to avoid heavy server traffic.
  • Keep your registered email ID and mobile number active throughout the recruitment process.
  • Take a printout of the final submitted application form and keep it safely along with the registration number and password.

If you disagree with any answer in the provisional key, follow these steps:

  1. Log in to your candidate portal on ssc.gov.in
  2. Go to the "Challenge/Objection" section for Delhi Police Constable Exam
  3. Select the question(s) you want to challenge
  4. Upload supporting documents or references (if required)

We are a collaborative, curious, and creative team of organizers, scientists, teachers, technologists, campaign veterans, and more who share the unwavering belief that we can use our gifts in service of transforming America â together. Weâve built our team guided by the belief that the whole is greater than the sum of its parts. And so we support each other relentlessly â rallying together to face challenges the same way we celebrate each otherâs wins.

About the Position

The Data Success Manager (Data Acquisition) is one of the people primarily responsible for the sourcing and collection of data utilized by our partners through our products and services. The members of the Data Success Team are expert problem solvers, familiar with modern databases, proficient in SQL and Python, and are able to deal with escalated issues involving data discrepancies and other data mysteries. Working with other Data Success Managers and Partnership Success Managers, you will serve as a key resource for our growing set of partners who are looking to our data-driven capabilities to support their electoral and organizing & advocacy efforts. You will become familiar with the data individual partners are utilizing to support their mission and provide input on how Murmurationâs capabilities can further drive their activity. The day-to-day work in this role will be supporting the range of data needs our partners haveâincluding helping to source,Â  load, and validate data in a variety of formatsâwhile also contributing to improvements in our data management practices and pipelines.Â  You will lead the effort to establish, manage, and improve the processes involved in data collection from both operational and technical angles. You will work with other members of the Success Team to help determine the prioritization of new data collection opportunities we use to support our partners and their data.Â Â 

In addition, as our team continues to grow, there will be increasing opportunities for this role to lean into other support activities we provide to our partners when capacity is available.

Job Level: P3

What Youâll Do

  • Establish and manage the operational processes to identify, evaluate, and source datasets that support Murmurationâs civic engagement partners across organizing, advocacy, and electoral campaigns;
  • Create and perform validation and quality checks on newly acquired datasets, including schema review, field-level analysis, completeness checks, and anomaly detection;
  • Clean, standardize, and prepare external datasets for integration into Murmuration systems using SQL and scripting tools;
  • Collaborate with internal teams (i.e., Data Success, Partner Success, and Research) to understand data gaps and recommend appropriate sourcing strategies;
  • Monitor ongoing data quality for sourced datasets and proactively flag degradation, inconsistencies, or compliance concerns;
  • Establish, implement, and share internal processes for dataset evaluation, vendor onboarding, and quality assurance;
  • As new datasets are collected, develop and maintain the necessary documentation and training for internal teams on how to use and understand these datasets; and
  • When responsibilities allow, taking an active role in partners' data success by supporting their campaign activities and work in the Organizer platform.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, as well as the ability to manage several tasks/projects concurrently and prioritize work effectively;
  • Strong operational management skills to build and own processes with stakeholder expectations around timeliness and quality;
  • Strong communication skills to interact effectively with various internal and external stakeholders to develop data strategy and collaborative partnerships;
  • An unquenchable desire to identify and fix data issues in a large, complex data environment (weâll rely on you to constantly be hunting for issues and not waiting to be reactive);
  • Moderate knowledge of SQL, including creating complex queries and manipulating large data sets; and
  • Moderate experience in scripting languages (Python, etc.)

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with voter file, election data, or other datasets containing personally identifiable information (PII) is a large plus;
  • Experience implementing data quality control best practices with both internal and external stakeholders;
  • Experience training stakeholders with varying levels of data literacy on how to understand and utilize different types of data;
  • Experience with business intelligence tools such as Sigma or Tableau; and/or
  • Experience with workplace productivity and collaboration tools, especially complex or integration-based workflows (i.e., Asana, Slack, Jira, Monday, etc.)

Talented candidates come from all walks of life and careers. If you are passionate about civic engagement and technology, please apply, even if you do not check every box!

Location and Compensation

The Data Success Manager (Data Acquisition) is a full-time, salaried position with a comprehensive benefits package (details below), open to candidates anywhere in the United States.

The starting salary for this position is $106,645. We set compensation using market data and apply it consistently across the organization to ensure fairness and transparency for everyone in similar roles.

Our Culture of Care

We work hard to create a culture of care to ensure that our staff are best equipped to lead happy, healthy, and balanced lives. To that end, we offer a comprehensive benefits package which includes:

  • Health, vision, and dental insurance with 100% of premiums covered for you and qualifying family members;
  • Retirement benefits with a 5% employer match;
  • A flexible, unlimited PTO plan;
  • Generous paid parental leave;
  • Pre-tax commuter benefits;
  • A company laptop;
  • A flexible remote work environment;
  • A home office setup stipend for all new employees;
  • Monthly reimbursement for remote work expenses;
  • A yearly professional development fund;
  • Mental health and wellness benefits through Calm and Better Help;Â 
  • Yearly in-person staff retreats; and
  • A welcoming culture that celebrates diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging.

At Murmuration, we believe a vibrant, representative democracy depends on the inclusion of diverse voices, lived experiences, and perspectives. The best ideas donât come from a single person or ideology â they emerge at the intersection of different backgrounds, identities, and viewpoints. We are proud of our commitment to building an organization and culture shaped by respect, empathy, and collaboration, where our teamâs diversity fuels innovation, civic engagement, and meaningful change. We welcome new colleagues who will help us nurture this collective effort. Join us.

An Equal-Opportunity Employer with a Commitment to Diversity

Founding Engineer (US)

Build the AI platform that's rewriting a $50B industry

Salary range - $180-220k USD + Equity + Benefits


About Haast

We're building one of the first agentic systems for enterprise legal and compliance teams that actually automates their manual work. End-to-end. Delivering 80% faster compliance reviews and 4x productivity gains.

We recently closed a $12M USD Series A (Peak XV Partners, DST Global, Airtree) and are growing fast in the US; building the infrastructure that will completely re-define how enterprises think about compliance.

Think Canva for design. Atlassian for projects. Haast for compliance.


The Problem

Compliance is a $50B global challenge. Enterprise legal and compliance teams spend a significant amount of time manually reviewing documents against policy, spotting regulatory risk, and signing off on content before go-to-market. It's painful and it's mission-critical.

We're building the infrastructure that makes this manageable at scale. You'll be working on systems that directly reduce risk and unlock productivity for some of the world's largest organisations.


The Role

As our first US based Engineer; you'll be the technical bridge between our product vision and our customers' reality.

You're a full-stack engineer who thrives at the intersection of innovation and execution, building our platform while staying connected to the teams actually using it.

You'll split your time between heads-down building (shipping code that matters) and being engaged with customers, understanding their pain points firsthand, iterating on features in real-time, and using that feedback to shape our product direction.

You'll own end-to-end technical decisions: designing systems, shipping to production, and iterating based on direct customer interaction.

This is high-autonomy work. You'll collaborate directly with our founding team, move at startup velocity, and have genuine influence over both our architecture and product roadmap.

What You'll Own

  • Design, architect, and ship full-stack features that directly solve our customers compliance challenges

  • Own the technical relationship with key customers; implementing solutions, gathering requirements, and translating feedback into product improvements

  • Build scalable services and APIs that power our LLM compliance platform while keeping the customer experience front and center

  • Make high-impact technical decisions quickly, knowing that you'll be accountable to both our engineering standards and our customers

  • Challenge assumptions on "why" and "how", you'll directly influence what we build and how we build it

Role Snapshot

Senior Site Reliability Engineer - AI Infrastructure

Location: Global Remote / San Francisco Â· Full-Time

About Andromeda

Andromeda Cluster was founded by Nat Friedman and Daniel Gross to give early-stage startups access to the kind of scaled AI infrastructure once reserved only for hyperscalers.

We began with a single managed cluster â but it filled almost instantly. Since then, weâve been quietly building the systems, network, and orchestration layer that makes the worldâs AI infrastructure more accessible.

Today, Andromeda works with leading AI labs, data centers, and cloud providers to deliver compute when and where itâs needed most. Our platform routes training and inference jobs across global supply, unlocking flexibility and efficiency in one of the fastest-growing markets on earth.

Our long-term vision is to build the liquidity layer for global AI compute â a marketplace that moves the infrastructure and workloads powering AGI not dissimilar to the flows of capital in the worldâs financial markets.

We are expanding to new frontiers to find the brightest that work in AI infrastructure, research and engineering.

The Role

This is not a generalist SRE role.

You will design, operate, and debug large-scale GPU infrastructure used for distributed training and inference, working directly with customers pushing the limits of modern AI systems.

Weâre looking for engineers who have personally run GPU clusters in production, understand the failure modes of distributed training, and can reason about performance from network fabric â kernel â framework.

What Youâll Own

  • GPU Cluster Architecture: Design and evolve multi-provider, multi-region GPU compute clusters optimized for large-scale training. Make topology-aware scheduling, networking, and storage decisions that directly impact training throughput and cost efficiency.

  • Customer Technical Partnership: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for customers running large-scale training workloads. Onboard, troubleshoot, and optimize, often in real time.

  • Reliability & Performance Engineering: Define SLOs and error budgets that account for the unique failure modes of GPU infrastructure (ECC errors, NVLink degradation, NCCL timeouts). Own capacity planning across heterogeneous GPU fleets optimized for training throughput.

  • Networking & Fabric Health: Ensure the health and performance of high-speed interconnects (InfiniBand, RoCE, NVLink) that underpin distributed training. Diagnose and resolve fabric-level issues that degrade collective operations.

  • Observability: Build deep visibility into GPU utilization, memory pressure, interconnect throughput, training job performance, and hardware health. Go well beyond standard infrastructure metrics.

  • Automation & Tooling: Build production-grade automation for cluster provisioning, GPU health checks, job scheduling, self-healing, and firmware/driver lifecycle management.

  • Incident Leadership: Lead incident response for complex, multi-layer failures spanning hardware, networking, orchestration, and ML frameworks. Drive blameless postmortems and systemic fixes.

What Weâre Looking For

  • GPU Systems Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience operating large-scale GPU clusters (NVIDIA A100/H100/B200 or equivalent). You understand GPU memory hierarchies, ECC behavior, thermal throttling, and hardware failure modes from direct experience not documentation.

  • High-Performance Networking: Production experience with InfiniBand, RoCE, or NVLink fabrics in the context of distributed training. You can diagnose why an all-reduce is slow, identify a degraded link in a fat-tree topology, and reason about congestion control at scale.

  • Distributed Training & ML Frameworks: Working knowledge of how large training jobs actually run â NCCL, CUDA, PyTorch distributed, DeepSpeed, Megatron, FSDP, or similar. You don't need to write the models, but you need to understand what's happening at the systems level when a 1,000-GPU training run stalls.

  • Linux & Systems Internals: Expert-level Linux knowledge: kernel tuning, driver management (NVIDIA drivers, CUDA toolkit), cgroup/namespace internals, performance profiling at the syscall and hardware level.

  • Kubernetes & Orchestration: Strong experience running Kubernetes in production with GPU workloads, including device plugins, topology-aware scheduling, multi-cluster federation, and custom operators. Experience with Slurm or other HPC schedulers is equally valued.

  • Automation & Software Engineering: Strong engineering skills in Python, Go, or Bash. You build production-grade tools and services, not just scripts. Infrastructure-as-Code proficiency (Terraform, Helm, Ansible, or equivalent).

  • Observability & Monitoring: Hands-on experience building monitoring and alerting for GPU infrastructure, not just Prometheus/Grafana basics, but GPU-specific telemetry (DCGM, nvidia-smi, fabric manager metrics) integrated into actionable dashboards.

  • Incident Management: Proven track record leading incident response for complex distributed systems where the failure could be in hardware, firmware, networking, drivers, orchestration, or application code and you need to narrow it down fast.

Strong Candidates May Have

  • Distributed Storage: Experience with high-performance parallel file systems (VAST, Weka, Lustre, GPFS) and the checkpoint I/O and data-loading bottlenecks that come with large training runs.

  • Training Optimization: Experience profiling and optimizing distributed training performance: identifying stragglers, tuning collective communication strategies, improving MFU (Model FLOPs Utilization), and reducing idle GPU time across large runs.

  • Cluster Buildout & Hardware: Experience involved in physical cluster design - rack layout, power/cooling constraints, network topology design, and hardware validation/burn-in at scale.

  • Team Leadership: Experience leading or mentoring a team of infrastructure engineers. We're growing and need people who raise the bar for everyone around them.

Why Youâll Love It Here

This is a high-impact, senior builderâs role. Youâll have significant ownership and autonomy to shape how our systems run at a foundational level, working directly with customers and providers while architecting the infrastructure backbone for reliable, scalable AI compute. Youâll influence technical direction and help define what world-class AI infrastructure operations look like.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Every department at Everfield HQ (HR, Finance, Legal, Acquisitions, Operations, etc) runs on processes that were designed before AI existed. Manual document review. Copy-paste reporting. Spreadsheets that someone, somewhere, built five years ago and nobody has dared to touch since.

We have already proven what happens when someone with the right skills and the right mandate shows up: portfolio companies that received sustained, hands-on AI attention moved from basic ChatGPT usage to deploying autonomous workflows in weeks. Now we need to bring that same energy to our own headquarters.

This is a new role. No predecessor, no playbook, no predefined toolkit. You will translate Everfield's AI strategy into department-specific roadmaps and then work shoulder-to-shoulder with HQ staff to execute them.

You will not be delivering workshops with sticky notes and leaving behind a slide deck. You will sit with a colleague, understand their workflow, prototype a solution together, and stay with them as they build confidence. You would rather ship a rough prototype on Tuesday than present a polished strategy deck on Friday.

What you will do

  • Map the territory. Assess AI maturity across each HQ department. Identify the biggest opportunities and build roadmaps that keep everyone moving in the same direction.

  • Build, not just advise. Develop proof-of-concept tools and workflow automations using AI APIs and low-code platforms. Prototyping is part of the job. Claude Code will become your main tool. We consider Zapier and n8n legacy software!

  • Enable through doing. Solve real problems alongside colleagues, in real time. Sit next to someone, show them what is possible and support them as they pick up new skills.

  • Automate the tedious. Turn manual processes into AI-powered workflows: document processing, data enrichment, reporting automation, and similar.

  • Create materials that scale. Build playbooks, templates, and training resources so adoption does not depend on your personal availability.

  • Prove the impact. Track adoption rates and report on ROI. We care about outcomes, not activity.

What success looks like

In your first 9 months:

  • AI maturity assessment completed for each HQ department

  • Every department has a documented AI Strategy and Roadmap document

  • A working AI agent delivered for HQ teams

  • Trusted working relationships in place with department heads

  • Hosted an AI Hackathon with the other AI colleagues

  • Real time savings demonstrated in at least one workflow

  • The beginning of a library of enablement materials produced

You will thrive here if you

  • Have 3â7 years of professional experience, ideally from management consulting, a startup environment, or both

  • Are genuinely fascinated by AI. Not from watching Youtube tutorials, but from building things yourself. You have a GitHub account with activity on it even though you are not a developer. You have tried the tools, broken them, rebuilt with them, and you have something you are proud to showcase

  • Have hands-on experience with AI APIs (Completions, Responses, Embeddings) from OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure, Bedrock, Openrouter or similar providers

  • Bring consulting instincts: stakeholder management, structured thinking, turning ambiguity into a plan

  • Can explain technical concepts to non-technical people without condescension or jargon

  • We are looking for someone early enough in their career to be genuinely immersed in how AI is changing work, with the hunger to build something from scratch

  • Are fluent in English. Additional European languages are a plus

You do not need to arrive as a finished product. The AI Lead will invest real time mentoring you, teaching you the enablement methodology, and helping you build technical depth. What you must bring is raw curiosity and the drive to learn fast.

What you will get

  • A career-defining role. You are building AI enablement for a European software ecosystem from scratch. This kind of scope does not exist at a single company.

  • Direct mentorship from an AI Lead who has personally driven AI transformation across multiple portfolio companies and wants to shape the next generation of AI enablers.

  • Real impact, fast. No six-month onboarding. You will be solving real problems in your first weeks.

  • Remote-first flexibility. Based anywhere in Europe, with occasional travel (up to 4 times a year).

  • Front-row seat to how AI is reshaping knowledge work, not in theory, but in the day-to-day reality of European software companies.

One of Pine Services Group's portfolio companies is adding a Vice President of Marketing to its leadership team. They are in an accelerated growth phase and are looking for a commercially minded, AI-forward marketing leader to help them get there.

This is a high-impact, build-it role. Our new VP of Marketing will join at a pivotal moment, one where the strategy is in motion but the marketing infrastructure, team, and pipeline engine need a decisive leader to own them. You will sit on the leadership team, partner directly with the CEO, and be accountable for both strategy and the results it drives.

  • Prioritize and track pipeline velocity, not just top-of-funnel volume

  • Own the company's event strategy, including industry conferences, vertical-specific events, webinars, and field marketing
  • Build content programs that establish the company as a credible voice in the ERP space
  • Oversee SEO, paid media, email marketing, and nurture programs, with a clear line of sight from channel investment to pipeline contribution
  • Lead and mentor the marketing team with a vision for scaling the function as the business grows

  • Champion an AI-first operating model across all marketing functions
  • Identify, evaluate, and deploy AI-powered tools that increase the team's output and quality without a proportional increase in headcount
  • Build repeatable, AI-enabled workflows for campaign execution, lead scoring, content generation, and competitive intelligence

Why This Opportunity
